title: Collections and Recovery Specialist at Volvo Financial Services (Vilnius or Riga)
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. What you will do At Volvo Financial Services you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry and society at large. The Collections & Recovery Specialist plays an important role in supporting portfolio quality and minimizing credit losses across Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia. The role combines analytical, operational and decision-support responsibilities by monitoring collections performance, preparing portfolio and overdue debt reporting, reviewing contract modification requests, and providing recommendations to support sound credit and collections decisions. The position reports to the Credit Manager at Volvo Financial Services Baltics. Main activities and core responsibilities: • Monitor collections and recovery performance across the Baltic portfolio. • Work with soft collections providers and directly with customers, as needed, to determine cause of delinquency and negotiate payment arrangements. • Prepare and maintain overdue debt (OVD), delinquency and collections performance reports for management. • Ensure data quality and consistency within collections and portfolio management reporting. • Analyze portfolio trends, identify risk areas and recommend corrective actions. • Review customer requests for contract modifications, payment extensions and restructurings. • Perform financial and risk assessment of modification requests and prepare recommendations for approval. • Initiate and handle termination of contracts due to default. • Coordinate Repossession and support Remarketing functions as required. • Support decision-making by providing portfolio, collections and recovery insights. • Monitor recovery performance and support actions aimed at maximizing recovered amounts. • Lead periodic collection meetings to discuss individual accounts and action items. • Drive continuous improvements in collections, recovery and contract administration processes. • Support implementation of new tools, products and business initiatives impacting collections activities. Who are you? In this role, you will bring: • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. • Minimum 3 years of experience in collections, credit, risk management, accounts receivables or financial analysis. Experience in a customer service or similar environment is an advantage. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to assess financial risks and identify appropriate mitigation actions. • Good understanding of leasing and loan products. • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment is an advantage. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. • Fluency in Lithuanian or Latvian and advanced level of English. What’s in it for you? We offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy: • Joining a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who make customers win. • Opportunity to grow both personally and professionally. • Space to initiate and implement improvements that create value for customers and the business. • Environment where we work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead. • Package of company benefits such as trainings, additional health insurance and more. Salary level: from 2.900€ to 3.600€ per month gross (before withholding taxes) depending on skills and experience. Also, annual bonus program will be applied in accordance with the Company policy. Ready for the next move? If you are a proactive professional with strong analytical capabilities, customer focus and integrity, we would like to meet you. Apply now to join Volvo Financial Services Baltics and help us maintain a healthy portfolio while delivering excellent customer support and sustainable business results. title: Market Risk Analyst
description: We are seeking talented professionals to join our Risk Management team. The market risk team plays a central role in analysing, measuring, managing, and communicating the risks associated with the Asset and Origination portfolios, including related hedging strategies. The team is also responsible for independent analysis and for supporting the implementation of new contracts in our risk systems. Regularly report on the performance (P&L) and risks associated with our Asset and Origination portfolios, providing accurate and timely information to stakeholders. Monitor energy market developments, regulatory changes, and their potential impact on our portfolios. Perform comprehensive risk assessments of transactions and deal structures before execution, identifying key risks and proposing appropriate mitigation measures. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including originators, portfolio managers, analysts, and credit risk teams, to ensure robust risk management and deal viability. Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk management processes and tools by sharing insights and proposing enhancements. We look for a Market Risk Analyst with the skills to future-proof our business and strengthen our market risk team. That includes: Advanced university degree in a quantitative discipline like Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics, Engineering or equivalent discipline. Knowledge of valuing and modelling derivatives is preferred. Programming experience (Preferably in Python). Strong attention to detail, integrity, and a proactive team player. Excellent communication skills with the ability to confidently engage with stakeholders. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Norwegian is an advantage but not required This position is suitable for candidates with prior experience in energy markets or risk management, as well as talented graduates with an interest in renewable energy markets.

title: Pflichtpraktikum im Bereich Controlling
description: Bei uns erhältst du die Chance, dein theoretisches Wissen direkt in die Praxis umzusetzen und wertvolle Erfahrungen in einem global agierenden Umfeld zu sammeln. description: Verantwortung für das geschäftsfeldübergreifende Sales Controlling und Sales Excellence in Zusammenarbeit mit den Geschäftsfeldern und der zentralen Vertriebsleitung. Koordination des Austauschs und der gemeinsamen Abstimmung von betriebswirtschaftlichen Kennzahlen mit den Sales Controllern der Geschäftsfelder. Schnittstellenfunktion in der Weiterentwicklung der Vertriebs- und Vertriebscontrolling-Tools sowie Methoden zur effizienten sowie effektiven Steuerung. Datenrecherche und Ermittlung von betriebswirtschaftlichen Kennzahlen sowie Aufbereitung und Plausibilisierung der Kennzahlen. Datenaufbereitung und Ermittlung der geschäftsfeldübergreifenden Kundenklassifizierung. Verfolgung der Vertriebsziele der Geschäftsfelder inklusive Erarbeitung vertrieblicher Handlungsoptionen. Governance-Funktion für Marketing- und Sales Controlling sowie Unterstützung beim Aufbau eines Prozesses zur nachhaltigen Sicherstellung der Datenqualität. Geschäftsfeldübergreifendes Monitoring Cross Selling. Inhaltliche Vorbereitung, Terminkoordination und Teilnahme an Sales Management Meetings. Koordination, Monitoring, Kommunikation, Ermittlung und Einspielung der Planzahlen/Zwischenstände in der Vertriebssteuerung. Mitarbeit in vertrieblichen Sonderprojekten. description_en: Responsible for cross-divisional sales controlling and sales excellence in collaboration with the business areas and central sales management. title: Master thesis - Understanding Retarder Stalk Usage Through Data Analytics and Machine Learning
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Modern heavy-duty trucks generate large amounts of vehicle data, offering valuable insight into driver behavior and vehicle performance. The retarder stalk lets drivers control auxiliary braking, but little is known about how drivers use its different positions, how often they switch between them, and how these patterns relate to braking behavior. By applying statistical and machine learning methods to real-world vehicle data, we can uncover usage patterns, identify what drives them, and support more efficient and intelligent vehicle control strategies. We are looking for two Master’s students who want to apply data analytics and machine learning to real-world vehicle data, and to contribute to data-driven improvements in heavy-duty vehicle development Thesis Scope The purpose of this thesis is to investigate how drivers interact with retarder stalk positions under real-world driving conditions and how different usage patterns relate to braking behavior and vehicle operation. The thesis is expected to: Analyze real-world vehicle data to characterize retarder stalk usage across driving sessions. Identify common usage patterns in stalk position distributions, transition sequences, dwell times, and switching frequency (e.g. Markov chain models). Discover driver usage profiles, such as stable usage, frequent changes, and short-term repeated transitions, using clustering methods (e.g. GMM, HDBSCAN) and latent-state models (e.g. HMM). Investigate the relationship between stalk position changes and braking behaviour before, during, and after transitions. Assess how driving conditions, such as vehicle speed, road gradient, and vehicle load, influence observed usage patterns. This project offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of data science, vehicle systems, driver behavior, and automotive engineering while addressing a real industrial challenge using high-frequency vehicle data. Who We Believe You Are You are currently pursuing a Master’s degree in: Data Science Computer Science or Computer Engineering Electrical Engineering Applied Mathematics You have a strong interest in: Data analytics and machine learning Time-series analysis, clustering, and behavioral pattern recognition Vehicle systems and automotive engineering Statistical analysis, visualization, and data-driven problem-solvin Experience with Python, large-scale datasets, or machine learning is considered an advantage. Familiarity with vehicle data or signal analysis is a plus. What You'll Gain Hands-on experience applying data analytics and machine learning to real-world, high-frequency vehicle data Insight into how data science supports heavy-duty vehicle development in an industrial setting Practical Information Thesis Level: Master's Thesis Number of Students: 2 Language: English Semester: Spring 2026 Application Deadline: November 6, 2026 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Starte deine Leadership Journey im Bereich Controlling
description: Bereit, die Performance von Bosch zu steuern? title: Master Thesis on Adaptive Distributed Control of Grid-Forming Battery Energy Storage Systems
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Background The increasing penetration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) has accelerated the transition toward sustainable transportation and resilient electrical grids. Modern BESS installations are evolving into modular systems composed of multiple battery systems and multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs). Current hierarchical control architectures enable coordinated operation, it also introduces communication dependency, latency and scalability challenges. This type of architecture relies on hierarchical communication between the Energy Management System (EMS), local BESS controllers and individual PCS controllers. Multiple communication layers may introduce delays, synchronization errors and reduced dynamic performance in the grid-forming operation. Communication failures or packet loss can degrade power sharing, frequency regulation and transient stability. Research Question The objective of this master thesis is to develop and validate an adaptive distributed control strategy for modular grid-forming Battery Energy Storage Systems comprising multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs) and multiple Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESSs). The proposed solution should reduce communication dependency, improve dynamic performance during power dispatch, enhance robustness against communication failures and delays, and provide a scalable control architecture suitable for future large-scale energy storage systems. Objectives Reduce dependency on hierarchical communication. Improve dynamic response during power dispatch. Maintain accurate active/reactive power sharing. Improve scalability for future modular BESS installations. Develop and evaluate virtual impedance control to reduce circulating currents caused by voltage, phase, and impedance mismatches among parallel PCSs. Scope Of Work Conduct a literature review on grid-forming converters, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control, hierarchical and distributed control architectures for modular BESSs. Review the limitations of hierarchical communication, the motivation for adaptive control under varying operating conditions, and the applicability of Model Predictive Control (MPC) for predictive power sharing and constraint handling. [Weeks 1-4] Develop a hierarchical grid-forming control model for multiple parallel PCSs and BESSs, including communication-based power dispatch, power-sharing control, and virtual impedance control. This model will serve as the reference for performance comparison. [Weeks 5-12] Design and implement a distributed adaptive control strategy that reduces dependence on hierarchical communication while maintaining stable grid-forming operation, accurate active/reactive power sharing, and robust performance under communication delays and failures. If appropriate, investigate MPC to improve predictive power dispatch and constraint management. [Weeks 13-21] Validate the proposed control strategy in MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS and/or PSCAD under representative operating scenarios, including load variations, communication delays, communication failures, and grid disturbances. [Weeks 22-26] Compare the proposed distributed control with the baseline hierarchical controller using performance metrics including active/reactive power-sharing accuracy, frequency and voltage deviations, settling time, circulating current, communication bandwidth, and overall system robustness. [Week 27-29] Candidate Competencies Two MS students with the solid backgrounds in electrical engineering, with basic knowledge of power electronics, control systems, and power systems Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation tools like PSCAD or DIgSILENT is desirable. Knowledge or previous experience in grid-connected converter control, BESS/PCS systems, adaptive or distributed control, and power-system stability is considered a merit. Ready for the next move? title: Bachelor thesis A Financial Framework for Prioritizing Online Condition Monitoring Implementation
description: Help Shape the Future of Smart Maintenance. As manufacturing becomes increasingly data-driven, organizations are looking for smarter ways to improve equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and maximize production availability. Online condition monitoring is a key enabler of this transformation, helping businesses move from reactive maintenance toward predictive and proactive strategies. We are now looking for two Bachelor students who want to explore how economic and operational data can be used to make better investment decisions regarding condition monitoring technologies. Thesis Scope The aim of this thesis is to investigate how online condition monitoring systems can be prioritized and implemented from an economic perspective. The project will focus on developing a decision support tool that helps identify where condition monitoring can create the greatest business value. The thesis is expected to: Develop a framework for evaluating condition monitoring opportunities across manufacturing equipment Assess machine criticality, maintenance costs, production availability, and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Combine technical and business-related data into a structured decision support tool Identify where condition monitoring solutions can generate the highest value Recommend approaches for improving maintenance planning, reducing costs, and increasing operational availability This project offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, maintenance, operations, and business economics while contributing to the future of smart manufacturing. Who We Believe You Are You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree within: Production Engineering Mechanical Engineering Industrial Economics Or a related field You have an interest in manufacturing, maintenance, data analysis, and continuous improvement. You enjoy solving complex problems and can combine analytical thinking with a practical business perspective. What You'll Gain Hands-on experience within a leading global manufacturing organization Exposure to predictive maintenance and condition monitoring technologies Opportunities to work with both technical and business stakeholders Insights into how data-driven decision-making supports operational excellence Valuable experience in developing practical tools that can support real business decisions Practical Information Thesis Level: Bachelor's Thesis Number of Students: 2 Location: Volvo Group Language: Swedish or English Semester: Spring 2027 Application Deadline: November 30, 2026 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Manager, Deal Finance & M&A
description: Manager, Deal Finance & M&A Location: Cambridge UK Introduction to the Role: AstraZeneca continues to pursue value-enhancing transactions that supplement its product portfolio and development pipeline, and to deliver maximum value from existing assets through the partnerships, collaborations, out- licences and divestments that create value and share risk. AstraZeneca Business Development is a globally integrated organisation with world-class capabilities in strategic planning, search & evaluation, transaction execution and alliance & integration management. It is varied, fast-moving work that offers an unrivalled opportunity to ‘make a difference ’. Within it, Deal Finance leads the financial aspects of Business Development and M&A — valuation, financial analysis and deal structuring — and provides dedicated support in the negotiation and execution of transactions globally. As a valued member of Deal Finance, the Manager provides dedicated financial support in evaluating and executing M&A, licensing, spin-out, collaboration and other structured transactions, working closely with senior Deal Finance colleagues. It is an ideal move for someone with a keen interest in the pharmaceutical industry who thrives in a fast-paced environment — whether taking their first step into industry or broadening their finance business-partnering skills — and who is genuinely excited about using AI to work smarter. Deal Finance is reimagining valuation and deal analysis for the AI era. You’ll use generative AI and automation to accelerate research, due diligence and modelling — freeing you to focus on judgment, insight and the relationships that close great deals. Here, technical skill and sharp commercial judgment are amplified by AI. Main responsibilities Support the construction of business cases, ensuring that all key issues, sensitivities and risks are evaluated and accurately reflected. Build accurate valuation and transaction models, using automation and AI-assisted tooling, that reflect the expected financial statement implications of potential transactions. Use generative AI and advanced analytics to accelerate industry research and company and product analysis, drawing insight from large, unstructured datasets. title: Developer & Business Analyst – PnL & Risk Systems
description: This role is ideal for a passionate, entrepreneurially minded developer who thrives on ownership , impact , and a dynamic environment. You will have end-to-end ownership of the solutions you deliver, from the first conversation with the business to final rollout and beyond. You will be trusted to shape the best approach to delivering against business priorities and timelines, in a flat, team-oriented environment that values ideas and individual contributions. Your role We have developed our own Commodity Trading Risk Management (CTRM) system that covers all aspects of our business activities across the globe: from trade entry through middle-office, with P&L reporting and price risk management, down to invoicing – for every commodity we trade, including electricity, renewables, gas, crude oil, refined products, biofuels, or carbon certificates. We place our CTRM at the heart of how the company operates; it is used daily by teams across trading, middle office, finance and operations. Our most critical systems are built in-house by teams like ours, helping orchestrate global energy flows. What defines success in this role: Technical excellence : design and implement clean, well-documented and extensible features. Write maintainable, high-performance code. Ownership: work with a high degree of autonomy and take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your deliverables: requirements, design, development, testing, rollout, training and ongoing support. Business partnership : engage directly with trading desks, finance and senior management to identify and prioritise requirements. There is no intermediary: you are both the business analyst and the developer. You go beyond what users explicitly ask for: understanding the context, spotting pain points they may not articulate directly, and building what truly serves the business. Teamwork : end-to-end ownership does not mean working alone. Your work integrates into a much larger system, and you stay closely connected with other development teams. You will become a trusted partner to colleagues and stakeholders across the firm. As we work as one united team covering PnL, Risk, VAR and options, the projects may be as diverse as: Helping redesign our CTRM reporting architecture to enable fast, scalable access for the demands of an AI-driven world Modelling cash-for-product loan repayments in our Finance P&L Building a valuation engine for complex options that we trade Running a systems integration with a company we have acquired For large projects, you may travel to other Vitol main offices – Houston, Singapore, London, Rotterdam – to ensure smooth integration and adoption on the ground. Our technology Our core technologies, PL/SQL and Oracle Forms Builder, form the foundation of our core trading platform and have been central to Vitol's success story. When you join, you will work with these established technologies to quickly get up to speed with our data model and business logic, and start adding value from day one. As our platform continues to evolve, we are progressively embracing a more contemporary technology stack, creating opportunities for those interested to be part of shaping what comes next. Required University degree in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or an equivalent field At least 3 years' experience as a software engineer, ideally in a role combining technical and functional responsibilities Proven data modelling skills to translate business situations into data structures Proficiency in SQL Team player with strong entrepreneurial drive and ability to work independently Proactive and user-focused "make it work" mentality with a genuine interest in both the functional and technical aspects of each challenge Comfortable with a daily release cycle and a fast-paced, results-oriented environment Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable engaging with non-technical and senior stakeholders Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken Nice to have Experience with PL/SQL (preferred) or a similar procedural DB programming language (e.g. T-SQL) Practical experience with Oracle Forms builder Previous experience in the commodities and/or trading industry Familiarity with PnL, accounting, or risk concepts French is a plus

Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided. Develop hands-on domain knowledge in your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them. title: Workforce Strategy & Talent Manager
description: At GSK, we unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We are a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We’re proud to be leading a healthcare revolution, and we’re looking for people who can help us deliver on our ambition. The Workforce Strategy & Talent Manager leads workforce planning, organisation design and capability strategy across DPTF (Digital Platforms and Technology Foundations). Provide workforce insight to the DPTF Leadership Team, covering capability, attrition, vacancy, skills coverage and talent risk. Support workforce transformation as the operating model changes, including the transition of roles and capability into the new structure. title: Lead Quant Analyst- Power Trading (m/f/d)
description: This is a high-impact role focused on shaping and enhancing the analytical framework that supports trading decisions across European power markets. The successful candidate will combine deep analytical expertise with a strong understanding of commercial trading environments. This is a key role in identifying market opportunities, developing analytical tools and frameworks, and ensuring that insights can be translated into actionable trading strategies and P&L generation. This position requires an individual who can work closely with traders, understand their requirements, independently develop solutions, and continuously challenge and improve the desk's analytical capabilities. This will be a full time position based in Dusseldorf, reporting into the Head of Continental Power Trading. The responsibilities will include as follows: Develop, enhance, and maintain analytical models, tools, and frameworks supporting European power trading activities. Translate complex market fundamentals, exposures, and trading opportunities into clear and actionable insights. Analyse market trends, supply-demand dynamics, generation, weather, transmission constraints, interconnectors, and other key drivers of power prices. Maintain and develop internal and external relationships to strengthen market intelligence. Evaluate existing analytical capabilities and define a roadmap for future development. Identify gaps in current tools, datasets, and market intelligence capabilities. Recommend and implement improvements to strengthen the desk's analytical edge. Work directly alongside traders to understand trading requirements and convert them into practical analytical solutions. Contribute ideas that enhance the desk's ability to generate P&L across European power markets. Communicate progress, priorities, requirements, and obstacles clearly and proactively. University degree in Mathematics, Economics, Science or similar. Substantial experience and proven track record in fundamental analysis and modelling of the European Power markets, ideally across more than one trading house. Extensive hands-on experience building and running fundamental models, with a track record of using them to form a clear, independent view on the market. In-depth knowledge of the German, French and UK power markets and the drivers that link them Knowledge of cross-border power flows, interconnectors, transmission constraints, and capacity markets. Strong understanding of how weather affects power demand, renewable output and prices A minimum of 5 years of experience operating in a commercial trading environment where analytics directly supported trading and revenue generation. Strong understanding of how traders identify opportunities, construct positions, and generate profit. Ability to take the models, data and tools we already have, build on them and improve them, rather than recreate what you have done elsewhere. A creative and curious approach, open to new methods and not tied to one way of doing things. Confidence to advise the Head of the Continental Power Trading desk on strategy, turning analysis into clear recommendations rather than just producing data. Demonstrated ability to independently deliver analytical projects from concept through implementation. A clear preference for analytics over trading, and motivation to build long-term analytical capability. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage in effective and direct communication at all levels. Strong analytical, problem-solving, with exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency in Python.

title: Produktmanager:in (w/m/d) I Decentralised Energy Solutions
description: Für die Vattenfall Next Energy GmbH suchen wir ab sofort eine:n Produktmanager:in (w/m/d) im Bereich Decentralised Energy Solutions am Standort Aachen, Berlin oder Hamburg . Als Produktmanager:in bist du Teil des Teams, dass unser Produktportfolio im Bereich dezentraler Energielösungen bestehend aus den Bausteinen Wärmepumpe, PV, Batterie, HEMS, Wartungsangeboten und Energietarifen für unsere B2C Kunden betreut und entwickelt. Du steuerst sämtliche Themen, die zum Produkterfolg führen und bist Schnittstelle zu relevanten Stakeholdern aus dem eigenen Unternehmen und externen Partnern. Deine Herausforderungen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Produktportfolios entlang des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und der Customer Journey mit Fokus auf Kundennutzen, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Markterfolg. Identifikation und Priorisierung von Produktanforderungen und Weiterentwicklungspotenzialen auf Basis von Kundenbedürfnissen, Vertriebsfeedback sowie Markt-, Wettbewerbs-, Technologie- und regulatorischen Entwicklungen. Konzeption und Umsetzung neuer sowie Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte und Produktlösungen, einschließlich der intelligenten Kombination von Wärmepumpe, PV, Batteriespeicher, HEMS, Wartungsangeboten und Energietarifen zu integrierten Kundenlösungen. Übersetzung von Produkt- und Business-Anforderungen in fachliche und IT-Anforderungen sowie Steuerung und Begleitung der Umsetzung gemeinsam mit IT, Operations und weiteren relevanten Fachbereichen. Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Value Proposition, Produktpositionierung und Pricing sowie Ableitung zielgruppenspezifischer Vertriebsargumente und Unterstützung von Marketing und Vertrieb beim erfolgreichen Go-to-Market. Steuerung des Produkterfolgs und der Wirtschaftlichkeit auf Basis relevanter Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Produktanalysen sowie Erstellung von Business Cases und fundierten Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management. Identifikation, Bewertung und Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmodelle und strategischer Partnerschaften, die unser Produktportfolio verbessern, erweitern oder neue Kundennutzen ermöglichen. Bewertung und Umsetzung produktrelevanter regulatorischer, rechtlicher und datenschutzrechtlicher Anforderungen sowie frühzeitige Ableitung von Handlungsbedarfen aus Veränderungen des Markt- und Technologieumfelds. Dein Profil Kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit unternehmerischer Einstellung, die kundenorientiert denkt und handelt und Lust hat Veränderungsprozesse einzuleiten und mit umzusetzen. Berufserfahrung in der Ausgestaltung und Umsetzung von kundenorientierten Prozessen. Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bzw. eine technische Qualifikation, z. B. als Meister im Bereich SHK oder Elektrotechnik. Nachgewiesene Erfolge bei der Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Aufrechterhaltung anspruchsvoller Salesstrategien vorzugsweise im Bereich Energy Solutions. Erfahrungen im Bereich Produktentwicklung oder -management. Business Development, Vertrieb u.Ä. sind von Vorteil. Du hast Lust eigenständig wechselnde Themen auch im Detail zu bearbeiten und zu meistern. Du erreichst praktisch einsetzbare Ergebnisse und hast dabei einen Blick für die Balance von Aufwand und Nutzen. In komplexen Situationen arbeitest Du strukturiert und denkst dabei regelmäßig in Prozessen. Du bist überzeugungsstark und setzt Medien gezielt zur Unterstützung ein (z.B. Präsentationen, KI).

description: Description For candidates seeking to be located at our Stevenage site, this role will temporarily be based at Stevenage. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. At GSK, we are committed to transforming outcomes for people with cancer through innovative science, bold ambition, and strong partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem. We focus our science where it can matter most - advancing care in cancers with high unmet need, grounded in a deep understanding of disease biology and deliberate scientific choices that connect discovery to meaningful impact in the real world. The Portfolio Integration Lead (PIL) is a senior role in Oncology Clinical Development, responsible for shaping the advancement of multiple oncology programmes from our portfolio with a focus on particular cancers. Working closely with both the VP and Clinical Development Leads (CDLs) and cross-functional teams across GSK, this role ensures scientific alignment, portfolio coherence, and development excellence across assets. This is a senior individual contributor position that operates across the full breadth of an Oncology portfolio rather than within a single programme, enabling cross-asset integration and strategic alignment across development activities. The PIL applies a disease-level clinical and scientific lens across the portfolio, integrating disease biology, biomarker strategy, and emerging clinical approaches to define what is scientifically feasible and inform development pathways across programmes. This includes bringing clinical context to novel biomarker strategies and trial designs, particularly for early-stage and mechanistically novel assets and across programmes with similar indications. The position is open to candidates from either a medical or non-medical background based on the expertise required to be successful operating at the intersection of oncology disease strategy, clinical development, and portfolio leadership. Ensure consistent cross-programme ways of working to improve development efficiency and execution. Drive cross-programme portfolio working groups and ensure business level alignment Drive and support clinical trial innovation based on evolving oncology treatment landscape, government regulations, basic/translational science, and emerging technologies (such as AI-enabled tools). Strengthen the scientific and strategic positioning of a pan-asset portfolio across multiple clinical and pre-clinical assets. Drive initiatives that advance data and technology strategies supporting development decision-making. Shape engagement with external experts and governance bodies including advisory boards where relevant. Prepare detailed strategic analyses and portfolio recommendations on behalf of the Disease Area Vice President, enabling effective decision-making at senior leadership and governance levels. title: Director Strategic Advice - Quality Science & Strategy
description: Do you want to shape how artificial intelligence is adopted responsibly in a global, science-led biopharmaceutical company? Come join us at AstraZeneca in the role as a Director Strategic Advice - Quality Science & Strategy . This is a rare opportunity to define, from the ground up, how a regulated organization adopts and governs artificial intelligence responsibly. You will set the guardrails, build the framework, and act as the trusted bridge between the technical realities of AI and the regulatory, quality, and business considerations that shape our industry. If you enjoy translating complex technology into clear, workable strategy — and influencing senior leaders to make sound decisions in a fast-evolving field — this role gives you the scope and impact to do exactly that. What you’ll do Provide proactive and strategic quality leadership in AI and data integrity : Lead the development of quality strategy and oversight approaches for AI-enabled, data-driven, and digitally supported activities across R&D, with a particular focus on trustworthy, reliable, and transparent use of data and algorithms. Establish guardrails — requirements, policies, and standards — for how AI is deployed in a regulated setting, including how data must be handled, governed, and used. Influence and build alignment with senior leaders , guiding strategic decision-making on AI adoption. Shape governance for AI- and data-related risk by providing clear insight, reporting, and recommendations to relevant decision-making forums. Maintain an external focus on AI, digital regulation, and data governance: Drawing on expert communities and networks to stay current with evolving AI regulations, standards, and industry practices, and translating these into practical guidance for the organization. Collaborate with and influences external stakeholders and regulatory bodies , representing AstraZeneca’s quality position and helping to shape expectations in evolving areas of science and technology. Provide expert input into quality and compliance risk management , including identification, assessment, mitigation planning and monitoring. Lead or support due diligence activities, inspections, audits and critical quality issue management , ensuring timely resolution and organizational learning. Essential Skills/Experience Significant experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical is preferred, but we welcome candidates from medtech, IVD, diagnostics, digital health, or other highly regulated sectors with transferable governance experience. Expertise in regulatory requirements relevant for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry Strong knowledge of AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, digital systems, and data lifecycle management Strong understanding of data integrity principles, data governance, and risks associated with computerized and AI-enabled systems Proven ability to influence senior leaders and provide strategic advice in complex, rapidly evolving scientific and technological environments A collaborative working style, comfortable partnering across functions and disciplines High ethical standards, trustworthy, operating with absolute discretion Location: Gothenburg, Sweden About AstraZeneca AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company. We focus on discovering, developing and commercialising prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. AstraZeneca Sweden plays a pivotal role in our shared global purpose - to better patients' lives. That’s why every one of us is motivated to make a difference. With a heritage that stretches back more than a century, we are extremely proud of our local reputation in Sweden. This is a place where the history and future of medicine come together. So, what’s next? Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you. We will go through the applications continuously so please apply as soon as possible but no later than August 20th, 2026. Welcome with your application! We want people to feel they belong at AstraZeneca and Alexion, starting with our recruitment process. We welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of characteristics. We offer reasonable adjustments/accommodations to help all candidates to perform at their best. title: Senior OT Network & Systems Engineer - Battery Energy Storage Systems - Volvo Energy
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Working at Volvo Energy is different Do you want to make the world a better place and love architecting digital solutions? Welcome to a team unified by an important mission, great ideas, fun, diversity, and inclusiveness. Our colleagues are - and will always be - the most important part of the story. Whilst demands are high, there is also plenty of opportunities to learn and grow - as a professional and as a person. We look for colleagues that thoroughly enjoy our intrapreneurial journey, can hit the ground running and lead with passion, perform with purpose and transform with vision. Moreover, it will be essential you have a strong ability to form trustful relationships to effectively work with partners - inside and outside of the Volvo Group – in a cross-functional manner. You will make a difference! Volvo Energy Digital & IT Digital & IT is a function within Volvo Energy. We support our customers transition to a carbon-free world through great Digital solutions and experiences that users love and enables customers to shift to fossil-free operations. We truly care about the customer’s business in terms of up-time, safety, productivity and of course 100% green energy supply. We aim at having industry-leading simplicity and usability for our digital services, such as routing, find-book-pay and charging operator systems. The energy transition will not come for free – but we are committed to support this transition by hard and dedicated work. So - what are we looking for in this specific role? Volvo Energy is providing a highly qualified digital platform, an Energy Management System (EMS), to control our Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We are now looking for Senior OT Network & Systems Engineer that will support in establishing cyber secure connectivity towards BESS units and the BESS digital twin using the appointed Volvo Energy Site Controller. As the energy space rely on standards for interoperability between energy systems, like Modbus, IEC 60870-5, 61850 and DNP-3, you make sure that the IoT Edge solution is designed according to cyber security standards. You also ensure cyber secure connectivity to the Volvo Energy EMS solution via MQTT/OPC-UA as defined by the Volvo Energy target architecture. You will work closely together with several different qualified teams to help design and build the solution and report functionally to the Volvo Energy Head of Enterprise architecture. Key Responsibilities In this role, you’ll take the lead in shaping the OT network architecture that powers our BESS units around the world. You’ll design secure, scalable network environments—everything from segmentation and VLAN structures to DMZ zones and redundancy strategies—both for our own products and for customer sites. As the technical owner of our OT networking landscape, you’ll create and maintain clear, high‑quality diagrams and documentation that bring structure to complex systems and ensure smooth integration with cloud platforms and external SCADA/EMS solutions. A big part of your work will center around cybersecurity. You’ll define modern firewall rulesets built on IEC 62443 and zero‑trust principles, validate safe communication paths for industrial protocols like Modbus, and take full responsibility for the lifecycle of our OT firewalls. That includes firmware updates, patching strategies, redundancy testing, vendor coordination, and the automated deployment of configurations across our global BESS fleet using FortiManager. You’ll also play a hands-on role in our production environments—diving into troubleshooting, leading root‑cause analysis, and contributing to cybersecurity assessments and audits that strengthen our defenses. Collaboration will be at the heart of your everyday work. You’ll partner with engineering teams at our assembly plants to ensure firewalls are configured correctly from the moment a unit is built, and you’ll work with Digital/IT teams to define secure, future‑proof IT–OT demarcation points. Along the way, you’ll also share your expertise with junior engineers and project teams, helping them grow while raising the overall technical bar. Required Qualifications 7+ years in OT networking, indus

title: Business Controller
description: Do you enjoy driving business performance from a central finance position? Are you an experienced finance professional who can turn complex financial data into strategic insights? Do you thrive in a role where you oversee the bigger picture, steer reporting processes, and support senior management with decision-making? We are looking for a Business Controller to join the Business Control team within Vattenfall's rapidly growing E-Mobility Business Unit. In this central controlling role, you will be responsible for providing insights into the overall financial performance of the Business Unit. You will act as a key partner to senior management, ensuring high-quality financial reporting, forecasting, planning, and performance steering across multiple countries and business areas. Working closely with Business Control colleagues, Finance teams, and senior stakeholders, you will help translate financial results into actionable insights that support the continued growth and development of Vattenfall's E-Mobility business. What will you do? As Senior Business Controller, you will play a key role in steering the overall financial performance of the E-Mobility Business Unit and ensuring a reliable and efficient reporting framework. You will: Coordinate and steer the monthly performance reporting cycle for the overall Business Unit. Consolidate financial results across countries, functions, and business areas into clear management reporting. Deliver insights and analyses on business performance, key value drivers, risks, and opportunities. Lead forecasting activities and translate business developments into reliable financial outlooks. Drive the annual budget and business planning process for the Business Unit. Support senior management with strategic analyses, business cases, and decision-making. Further develop and improve reporting standards, controlling processes, and governance frameworks. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency in financial reporting and performance measurement. Collaborate closely with Business Controllers, Accounting, and Finance teams across different countries. Identify opportunities to automate and enhance reporting tools, KPIs, and management information. Contribute to cross-functional improvement initiatives that support the continued growth of E-Mobility. You will report to the Director of Business Control E-Mobility and work closely with stakeholders across multiple countries and disciplines. Who are you? You are able to combine strong analytical capabilities with a strategic mindset and enjoy understanding how financial performance connects to broader business objectives. You are comfortable working with large amounts of data, creating structure in complex environments, and translating financial outcomes into meaningful insights for senior stakeholders. You can switch effortlessly between detailed financial analysis and high-level performance discussions. With a proactive and collaborative approach, you build strong relationships across the organisation and contribute to continuous improvement. We believe you bring: At least 7 years of experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, FP&A, Corporate Finance, or a similar finance-related role. A master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience with consolidated reporting, forecasting, and business planning in a complex international organisation. Strong analytical and financial modelling skills. Experience working with senior stakeholders and management teams. The ability to translate complex financial information into clear and actionable recommendations. Advanced Excel and presentation skills; experience with SAP and reporting tools is highly valued. Full professional proficiency in English. Experience within the utilities, energy, infrastructure, or other asset-intensive industries is considered an advantage. Location: Berlin, Stockholm or Amsterdam

title: Senior Business Analyst
description: Digital Transformation plays a critical role across Statkraft’s value chains. In Markets, reliable digital solutions, strong analytical capabilities and close collaboration between business and technology are essential to manage risk, support financial reporting and make well-informed commercial decisions. Many of our business-critical systems are developed and maintained in-house. We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join the team responsible for Beacon, our Portfolio and Risk Management platform, as well as the team responsible for Risk IT Tools, a suite of business-critical solutions that bridge business and IT and support risk analysts, quant teams, and developers. Together, these teams play a key role in enabling efficient risk management, reporting, analytics, and process automation across Statkraft's trading landscape. As a Senior Business Analyst you will: Act as a key link between Markets and IT, connecting business needs with effective digital solutions. Work with business users, quantitative analysts and developers to understand needs and translate them into clear requirements and acceptance criteria. Analyse financial models, valuation methodologies, quantitative calculations and business processes to support solution development. Coordinate dependencies between Beacon, internal models and the wider Risk IT landscape. Drive priorities and support delivery from initial business need through implementation, testing and validation. Support the continuous improvement of risk management, reporting, analytics and process automation solutions. Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to ensure solutions work effectively across systems and meet business needs. The position may be based in either Oslo or Düsseldorf, depending on the competence and profile of the successful candidate. We are looking for colleagues who are excited to make an impact and bring a mix of mindset and skills to the team. This includes: Extensive experience as a Business Analyst in complex, business-critical IT or digital product environments. Strong analytical and financial-market knowledge, including an understanding of financial models, valuation methodologies and quantitative calculations. Relevant experience in areas such as energy trading, derivatives, risk management, valuation, market or credit risk, or financial reporting. Practical Python experience for data analysis, investigation, prototyping or automation, and the ability to understand and discuss code with technical colleagues. A structured, hands-on approach with the ability to work independently, explore details and take ownership through implementation and validation. Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, combined with experience working in agile, multidisciplinary teams. Higher education in engineering, computer science, mathematics, economics, finance or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

You will actively shape strategic and operational projects, for example in the areas of restructuring and M&A, employer branding, performance management, or digitalization. You will take ownership of your own work packages or projects, prepare executive management decisions, and implement sustainable improvements together with international and local teams. You will develop your personal career profile through deliberately combined HR and business rotations, regular feedback, and guidance from your personal executive-level mentor. title: Senior Specialist, Investment Analysis and Business Cases
description: Location: Wrocław / Hybrid At Fortum, we are driving the decarbonization of district heating and the energy system and developing innovative energy solutions that support the transition towards a cleaner and more flexible energy future. We are looking for an experienced and analytical professional to work with investment analysis and business case development, assessing project economics and providing recommendations for strategic investments across Fortum's energy portfolio. The role will be 50/50 split between supporting investment decision-making in heat and energy business in Poland and working closely with our Nordic and international battery energy storage (BESS) team on the development and assessment of battery storage investments and new energy system solutions. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of engineering, economics, and business strategy, supported by technical, commercial and market experts across Fortum. The role may also involve developing more advanced techno-economic and simulation-based business cases, including hybrid solutions combining BESS with generation, industrial loads, data centres and other flexible assets. title: Commercial Manager (18-month temporary position)
description: As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. We are looking for a Commercial Manager to join our Commercial Operations team on a temporary full-time basis for 18 months . In this role, you will have end-to-end commercial responsibility for assigned offshore wind assets in Germany. Acting as the key commercial partner to Site Management, you will manage a broad range of operational contracts, drive commercial performance, and ensure contractual risks and opportunities are effectively managed. Working closely with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Asset Management, and external suppliers, you will help create commercial value, support efficient operations, and contribute to continuous improvement across the assets. What will you do? Commercial Management Partner with Site Management on commercial, contractual, and financial matters. Provide commercial analysis and recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions. Identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities. Support budgeting, forecasting, and performance reviews. Lead or support commercial negotiations and contract-related discussions. Contract Management Manage operational contracts throughout their lifecycle. Monitor supplier performance and compliance with contractual obligations. Handle contract variations, claims, and commercial disputes where required. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and key internal stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Drive improvements to commercial processes, reporting, and ways of working. Identify and implement value-creation and cost-saving opportunities. Promote best practices and share lessons learned across assets and functions. Who are you? You are a commercially driven professional with experience in contract and supplier management within a complex operational environment. You combine strong analytical skills with a pragmatic mindset and are comfortable working with both commercial details and broader business objectives. You build strong relationships, communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, and take ownership of delivering results. Structured and proactive by nature, you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift and no two days are the same. Next to this you bring: A degree in a commercial, legal, engineering or similar discipline Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract, commercial or procurement roles — preferably in renewables, energy, oil & gas, or other complex industries Experience interpreting, managing, supporting and negotiating commercial agreements supported by a strong commercial mindset Experience with operational renewable energy assets Ability to manage many tasks simultaneously with structure and prioritization Experience working with suppliers and external stakeholders Must be able to manage and negotiate contracts in English German language is a plus, not a must Location: Amsterdam (Netherlands), Kolding or Copenhagen (Denmark), Hamburg (Germany) or London (UK)

title: Director, Analytics Engineering (2 Openings)
description: Job Description Summary #LI-Remote Novartis has an exciting opportunity for a Director, Analytics Engineering. This role is responsible for building next-generation, AI-powered automated data pipelines and scalable data repositories that enable enterprise data science and analytics at scale. By leveraging advanced AI technologies, modern data engineering tools, and feature engineering platforms, this director creates self-service, analytics-ready datasets and enterprise feature stores that empower both expert data scientists and citizen data scientists to rapidly develop, deploy, and scale models. This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel. There are 2 positions available. Job Description Major accountabilities: Design and implement intelligent, self-healing data pipelines that leverage AI/ML for automated data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and remediation. Build and maintain centralized feature stores that enable feature reusability across multiple models and use cases. Create curated data repositories optimized for data science/AI workflows, including training datasets, evaluation datasets, and production serving layers. Develop automated feature engineering pipelines that transform raw data into analytics-ready features with lineage tracking. Partner with Enterprise IT to optimize analytics platform architecture for high-performance data science workloads. Build automated pipelines that integrate diverse data sources including sales, CRM, patient claims, real-world evidence, and unstructured data. Create self-service data access layers that empower data scientists and analysts to query and extract data independently. Establish SLAs for data availability, freshness, and quality; implement monitoring and observability solutions. Essential Requirements Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; 7+ years of experience in data engineering, ML/AI engineering, or analytics infrastructure. 5+ years leading teams building enterprise-scale data platforms and feature stores. Expert knowledge of feature store technologies (Feast, Tecton, SageMaker Feature Store, Databricks Feature Store). Deep expertise in modern data platforms optimized for ML workloads (Databricks, Auto ML, Snowflake, BigQuery). Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark for large-scale data processing. Experience with data orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, dbt) and CI/CD for data pipelines. Understanding of data governance, privacy (HIPAA, GDPR), and compliance in life sciences. Preferred Qualities Proven track record of implementing AI/ML-powered automation in data engineering workflows. Strategic thinker who can balance innovation (cutting-edge AI tools) with reliability (production stability). Builder mindset with ability to create scalable, self-service capabilities that reduce dependency on data engineering. Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry. Knowledge of streaming technologies, MLOps tools, and data lakehouse architecture. Novartis Compensation Summary: The salary for this position is expected to range between $194,600 and $361,400 per year. The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors. Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards. US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. title: Head of Global Financial Services
description: Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, which enable our customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. We are looking for you, Head of Global Financial Services to join our Group Finance organization in Neste headquarters in Espoo. You will focus on leading a global shared service center, Neste Global Financial Services (GFS), which is responsible for timely and accurate monthly, quarterly and annual statutory reporting to internal stakeholders, external auditors and authorities. The service scope includes Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payments, Asset and Inventory Accounting and General Accounting for Neste subsidiaries across Renewable Products and Oil Products business areas. In this job you will work closely with your own highly skilled GFS leadership team, top-tier finance professionals across the Neste Group, and key function and business stakeholders globally. In our team, you will be part of a well-motivated and experienced group of professionals who are driven to continuously improve our processes and develop our talents. As a team, we aim to elevate our financial operations and support Neste's strategic decision-making. Together with your expertise, we can do meaningful work to drive Neste forward. Reasons to join We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate. We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment. Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging. In addition, our benefits for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, good occupational health care, a membership in a sickness or health insurance fund and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure time activities, e.g. by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi). More about the job Your role in our team Leading the Global Financial Services department’s overall performance, including heading your own leadership team of 7 direct reports and an organization of 65+ finance professionals based in Espoo, Finland. Ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting while leading robust financial service processes with strong global internal controls. Maintaining and developing the global service delivery model and fostering strong partnerships with key stakeholders and counterparties. Driving end-to-end process development, continuous improvement, and financial service automation. Participating in IT systems renewals and M&A projects to provide all potential new group companies with scalable, proper financial services. Keys to success in this role Applicable education, e.g., Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance, combined with at least 10 years of relevant work experience. Proven track record in leadership, including providing strategic direction, coaching managers, driving team performance, and fostering global collaboration. Expertise in timely/accurate reporting, internal control frameworks, and running cost management. Solid knowledge of financial processes, systems (especially SAP FI), and accounting principles (IAS/IFRS and Local GAAPs). Experience in end-to-end process development, automation methods (e.g., RPA and AI), and participation in finance IT system projects. Proactive and analytical approach, high adaptability to changing situations, and a strong sense of ownership. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, positive mindset. Let’s get you started We look forward to receiving your CV and application with a salary request by August 31, 2026. Please note that the review of applications will start already during the application period, so submit your application right away! If you have any questions regarding the process or the position, please get in touch with Kaisa Koivuranta, Vice President, Group Finance +358 50 458 4985 on Friday 14

description: Team Introduction You will join GSK’s Global Procurement organisation, focusing on Global Distributor Management & Commercial Operations. Working closely with Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal and Compliance teams, you will help shape how GSK partners with pharmaceutical distributors and related service providers across international markets. Position Summary In this role, you will lead the global procurement strategy and commercial management for GSK’s distributor network. You will be accountable for sourcing, contracting and governance of pharmaceutical distributors and commercial operations providers that support product availability, market access, customer service and supply chain execution. You will develop and manage strategic relationships that optimise service, cost and risk performance across multiple markets. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a global procurement and supplier management strategy for pharmaceutical distributors and commercial operations partners, aligned to GSK’s business objectives. Lead strategic sourcing, selection, onboarding, contracting and ongoing governance of distributor partners across international markets, ensuring robust compliance and partner performance. Establish and maintain distributor performance management frameworks, including KPIs, SLAs, scorecards and governance routines to drive service excellence and continuous improvement. Negotiate complex commercial agreements with distributors, ensuring balanced commercial outcomes, clear accountabilities and long-term value creation. Assess distributor capabilities, operational performance, inventory management practices and customer service effectiveness, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, resilience and quality. Drive cost optimisation, service enhancements and risk mitigation initiatives across the distributor network in collaboration with Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal and Compliance stakeholders. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. business, supply chain, finance, engineering or related discipline). Significant experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare or broader life sciences industry. Proven experience in procurement, strategic sourcing or commercial management involving pharmaceutical distributors or similar channel partners. Strong understanding of pharmaceutical distribution models, distributor operations, channel management and commercial supply chains. Demonstrated track record of negotiating complex commercial agreements and managing supplier performance in a global or multi-market environment. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and alignment across diverse functions and geographies. Preferred Qualifications Extensive pharmaceutical industry experience, ideally with direct exposure to global distributor, wholesaler, specialty distributor or channel partner networks. Knowledge of GDP requirements and international healthcare supply chains, including associated regulatory and compliance considerations. Strong executive presence with clear, confident communication and advanced negotiation skills, enabling effective engagement with senior internal and external stakeholders. Why this role? This is a high-impact role at the centre of GSK’s distributor and commercial operations strategy. If you are motivated by building strategic partnerships, optimising complex supply chains and delivering sustainable value for patients and customers worldwide, we encourage you to apply. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. description: The Trading Business Support team owns and continuously improves the operational platform for the Proprietary Trading department. It is the central point of contact for operational and administrative matters and works across Proprietary Trading, internal support and control functions, and external stakeholders. The team ensures efficient and stable trading operations, develops scalable processes and governance frameworks, supports transparent financial reporting and effective cost management, and delivers strategic initiatives that enable the continued development of the business. As a Senior Business Analyst in the Trading Business Support team, you will: Take business ownership for strategic business development and improvement initiatives, translating objectives into structured plans and measurable outcomes and driving delivery from assessment and business case through stakeholder alignment, execution and transition into stable operations. Lead or coordinate cross-functional workstreams involving Proprietary Trading, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, IT and operational support teams. Own financial planning and cost management for the Proprietary Trading department in close collaboration with Controlling & Performance Management, coordinating budgeting, forecasting, periodic reviews, cost allocations, analysis and management reporting to ensure accurate, timely and decision-relevant information. Act as a key interface between Proprietary Trading and finance-related departments, including Controlling & Performance Management, Financial Reporting, Accounting, Procurement, Tax and other relevant support functions. Coordinate business input, resolve data and process issues, and document workflows and assumptions to ensure Proprietary Trading activities are executed, evaluated and processed accurately and consistently. Improve processes and controls for shared services including market data, technology and analytics to maximise value for the department. Contribute to audit readiness by preparing supporting documentation, coordinating responses and ensuring that agreed actions are implemented. Map, define, document and continuously improve end-to-end processes and governance within Trading Business Support and the wider organisation, addressing structural gaps and clarifying ownership, roles, service expectations, controls and escalation paths. Handle administrative matters required to support the department and act as the first line of support during operational incidents, coordinating initial assessment, communication, escalation and follow-up with the relevant teams. Represent the Propr Trading department in projects, working groups and governance forums, and ensure that agreed outcomes are implemented effectively. Build and maintain constructive relationships across an international stakeholder landscape, both internally and externally. University degree in business administration, economics, finance, accounting, business engineering or a related field. Several years of relevant professional experience in business management, consulting, advisory, project management or a comparable role. Experience in commodity trading, energy markets, financial services or another complex and regulated environment is an advantage. Commercial mindset, strong service orientation and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to supporting stakeholders and the confidence to challenge constructively and influence senior decision-makers. Ability to structure ambiguous topics, apply sound judgement, balance strategic and operational priorities, and work independently with a high level of accountability. Track record of taking ownership for cross-functional initiatives and delivering complex business and process changes from concept through implementation. Proven experience in defining, improving and implementing end-to-end business processes, including governance, controls, roles, documentation and interfaces. Strong understanding of financial reporting principles, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, cost allocation and financial performance management. Experience supporting audit activities, financial and process controls, reconciliations or the resolution of reporting and data-quality issues. Strong analytical skills and a high affinity for data, digital tools, financial systems and management information; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is expected. Excellent stakeholder-management and communication

description: We are looking for a Tax Manager – Tax Reporting, Risk Management & Technology to join our global tax team. In this role, you will ensure accurate and timely tax reporting across budget, forecast, and actuals, while developing and implementing a robust tax risk management framework for the ContiTech Group. You will act as a key contact for German and international entities, proactively identifying tax risks and supporting operational tax functions. This position offers a unique opportunity to work independently in a small global team with a broad range of responsibilities and close interaction with the business. Leverage technology and digital tools to enhance tax reporting accuracy and risk management efficiency. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. This role also has the responsibility of coordinating and consolidating the local Marine Market reporting and business performance. The person reports directly to the Head of Marine Market Asia and plays a key part in supporting the local organization in all matters related to financial and operational controls. The Head of Finance & Business Support is essential for ensuring compliance with AB Volvo’s policies, guidelines, and legal requirements, while also leading a local Business Support Team to ensure smooth execution of processes. The Head of Finance & Business Support ensures seamless coordination of operational and financial activities, driving efficiency, compliance, and support to the business in achieving its goals within the Marine Market Asia and Market Unit South East Asia.
